reason: Of the three prospectively declared prompt compatibility variants, helpful-system plus a joint see/hear question recognized impacts in the original and silence in the muted clip. The official-system variant hallucinated sound in silence. This small positive is insufficient for admission; test one flat rating format against the original two-source control battery.
scope: Eight cases: original/muted/+750 ms delayed audio on each of the two frozen calibration control sources, plus fresh-conversation original/muted repeats of Combat-only. No new source or held-out output.
gates: Retain original silence, synchronization-direction, repeatability and full six-dimensional calibration requirements. Invalid or unassessable sync cannot pass a directional gate. A plausible JSON object does not prove audio perception.
failure_policy: No further wording search under this model configuration if this frozen control battery fails. Preserve every raw response and failure; prefer a separately justified model/metric change to prompt fishing.
